NONE: › everywhere or everything
到處，遍及；一切

C: › a book consisting of two or more parts that have already been published separately
（若干已發表作品的）選集，匯編
› UK a programme consisting of two or more parts that have already been broadcast separately
（由曾播出的節目組成的）節目連播

example: the omnibus edition of a soap opera

NONE: › used to describe an antenna (= a piece of electronic equipment that connects radio or computer networks) that can receive or send signals in all directions
（天線）全方向的
› having unlimited power and able to do anything
全能的，萬能的，無所不能的

example: How can a loving, omnipotent God permit disease, war and suffering?
慈愛、萬能的主怎會允許疾病、戰爭和苦難的存在？

NONE: › present or having an effect everywhere at the same time
無所不在的，遍及各處的

example: The singer became an omnipresent icon of style and beauty.
這位歌手成了一個時尚與美麗的符號，無所不在。

NONE: › having or seeming to have unlimited knowledge
無所不知的，全知的
› the voice in which a story is written that is outside the story and knows everything about the characters and events in the story
（故事寫作中的）全知敘事者
› a situation that is bad in many different ways, because things have been organized badly and serious mistakes have been made
（因為組織糟糕和嚴重錯誤導致的）各方面都很糟糕的局面

example: The implementation of the new policy was branded an "omnishambles" by the Opposition spokesperson on education.
這項新政策的實施被反對黨教育事務發言人形容為「全面的糟糕」。

NONE: › an animal that is naturally able to eat both plants and meat
雜食動物
› naturally able to eat both plants and meat
雜食性的
› enthusiastic and interested in many different areas of a subject
興趣廣泛的
